entries.prompt: Sukhoi Su-57 stealth fighter of the Russian Aerospace Forces, exact head-on front view (camera on the aircraft's centreline at cockpit height, straight at the nose), standing on its landing gear on a concrete apron in daylight, photographic reference. Pointed nose with a single-piece bubble canopy, the two widely spaced rectangular engine intakes under the leading-edge root extensions, the movable LEVCON leading-edge root surfaces, thin swept wings, the two small all-moving vertical fins canted outward, the two widely separated engine nacelles with a flat tunnel between them, tricycle landing gear. Grey digital camouflage. Whole aircraft in frame and symmetric, no people, no text.
